title.narrative: Integrated Nutrition, WASH, Agriculture and Health Response to Address Malnutrition

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtBugna woreda is one of the most nutrition and food insecure woreda in Amhara region. Different assessments indicated the level of nutrition service availability, health care facilities, WASH services and agriculture production impacted by interconnected problems particularly existing conflict. ltbrgtORDA Ethiopia has a long year existence with a robust presence and extensive experience in the area. In the woreda ORDA Ethiopia is providing different services like food aid through JEOP and Resilience Food Security Activities (RFSA). Therefore, ORDA Ethiopia is uniquely positioned to address the pressing humanitarian needs and response priorities arising from insecurity, and drought impacts of multi-crisis affecting the woreda’ s communities.ltbrgtThe project intervention aims to mitigate the multifaceted challenges faced by over 31,500 vulnerable individuals severe impacted by ongoing conflict-driven and drought. Leveraging their existing expertise with the ongoing on project implemented in Bugna woreda, ORDA will focus on key sectoral interventions such as Nutrition, Health, Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) and Agriculture inputs.ltbrgtNutrition is the key agenda for this intervention, therefore nutrition support interventions like health service, WASH and Agriculture are the main components.ltbrgtIn the nutrition sector, a total of 5,899 children under five and 1,468 pregnant and lactating women will benefit from nutritional screening, supplementary feeding, and therapeutic programs. Among them, 3,567 children under five with moderate acute malnutrition (MAM) will receive targeted support through a supplementary feeding program, which will be complemented by Ready-to-Use Supplementary Food (RUSF) supplies. Additionally, 460 children under five diagnosed with severe acute malnutrition (SAM) without medical complications will be enrolled in the Outpatient Therapeutic Program (OTP) and treated with medical supplies and Ready-to-Use Therapeutic Food (RUTF). For 82 children under five with complicated SAM, admission to a stabilization center is planned, where they will receive medical treatment, nutritional therapeutic supplies, and therapeutic feeding milks. Furthermore, 1,205 pregnant and lactating women with MAM will benefit from targeted supplementary feeding, supported by Corn-Soy Blend ++ (CSB++)ltbrgtUnder health component the project will address 17,020 people will address by basic primary health care services. For this action the project will deploy mobile health and nutrition teams, procure and deliver basic medical supplies, non-medical supplies and provide different trainings for health professionals and community representatives ltbrgt ltbrgtAgriculture interventions including Provision of improved locally adapted drought-tolerant crop seeds for 1500 households, Provision of nutritious vegetable seeds with agricultural farm tools for 245 vulnerable households, Provision of income-generating activities to the most vulnerable 100youths households, Support of restocking of animals (small ruminant animals (sheep/goat) livestock -sheep/goats) for 250 vulnerable HHs including improved forage seeds and 5000 households having livestock will Support livestock veterinary drug and vaccination of animals to mitigate livestock losses.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtDuring the project period, ORDA Ethiopia will provide access to clean water for 31,500 individuals by different means. Out of the total beneficiary 16,207 individuals will reach through rehabilitation of 21 water schemes across the target kebeles and for 15,295 individuals by Provision of water treatment chemicals or purification tablets-(Bishan tab) for 12 months. Additionally 31,500 individuals’ will receive WASH NFIs like laundry and bathing soap, 2000 household will receive water storage containers, 3780 vulnerable female in productive age will receive Reusable Sanitary Napkins/pads (2-pack per woman/girl), and 3780 vulnerable female in productive age will receive Underwear (2- pairs per woman/girl).ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtlt/pgt
